rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for referring to a later time or what happens after something.

example.english: We went shopping afterwards after eating.
example.traditional: 食完飯之後，我哋去行街。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 haang4 gaai1

rows.note: Use this colloquial form when describing the next step in an ongoing sequence.

example.english: We order first, and afterwards we wait for a table.
example.jyutping: sin1 lok6 daan1 gan1 zyu6 dang2 wai2

rows.note: Use this mainly to link successive actions or events, meaning “then” or “after that.”

example.english: I took a shower and went to bed afterwards.
example.jyutping: ngo5 cung1 jyun4 loeng4 jin4 hau6 fan3 gaau3
